create.title: Complete square-root large-value distribution and improved recorded circle moments
create.statement_tex: For fixed real even Schwartz Psi, fixed bounded measurable nonnegative w supported in [c,C] subset (0,infinity), real T>=2 and every real U>=0, let B_(T,U)(R)=sum_(n>U)r_2(n)n^(-3/4)Psi(sqrt(n/T))cos(2pi R sqrt(n)-3pi/4). Uniformly in U and V>=1, D_(T,U)(V)=integral w(R/T)1_(|B_(T,U)|>V)dR <<_epsilon T^epsilon(V^(-2)+T V^(-136/13)). The proof includes singleton n=1, all partial dyadic blocks, the infinite Schwartz tail, the exact Gram diagonal and the full localization ceiling. For Psi the Fourier transform of a fixed nonnegative real radial smooth unit-mass mollifier supported in the unit disk, theta=theta_LY and beta=2theta-1/2, every fixed p>=2 satisfies integral w(R/T)|B_(T,0)(R)|^p dR <<_(p,epsilon) T^(1+epsilon)+T^((p-2)beta+epsilon). The same moment bound holds for U=floor(T^(1/2047)), not asserted uniformly for all U. For the inclusive sharp discrepancy and real Y>=4, integral_(Y/2)^(3Y)|P(x)|^p dx <<_(p,epsilon)Y^(1+p/4+epsilon)+Y^(1+(p-2)theta+epsilon). In particular p=12 gives Y^(1+10theta+epsilon), normalized sixth-power norm T^(5beta+epsilon), and the conjectural-order moment endpoint q_star=2+1/beta>262/27. This improves the recorded project moment comparison without a novelty claim. It does not prove the stronger Round204 distribution, any M1/M2 parent, a better pointwise exponent or the quarter theorem. The aligned arbitrary-coefficient control explains the generic diagonal term; it is not an arithmetic counterexample.
